name: AECi — Algolia index drift (D1 ≠ Algolia)
message:
An Algolia index's object count no longer matches its promoted D1 rows (AECI-140 daily check, §23.1). Positive drift = the index is missing rows; negative = it holds orphans. The gauge is the pre-heal snapshot: negative drift (orphans) self-heals in the same 09:00 UTC cron via the orphan sweep (AECI-266) and should read 0 the next day; positive drift is repaired by the 08:00 incremental sync. Investigate if drift persists across runs.

Note: notify_no_data fires if the daily 09:00 UTC (= 04:00 EST) cron (apps/api/src/scheduled.ts) did not report for 48h — the job itself may be down.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#algolia-index-drift
